testsuite.name: com.chromascape.web.debug.patchloop.websocket.PatchLoopWebSocketHandlerTest

testcase.name: Replay buffer works for late-joining clients
Broken session is removed from tracking after send failure
Broadcast fallback to all sessions when no execution subscribers
Broadcast to execution subscribers does not throw when a session is broken
Broadcast handles concurrent session failures without throwing
